note: Defect candidates observed in frozen source. Each carries a reproducible case and an explicit observed-vs-intended label. Execution evidence belongs to test-engineer/verifier; nothing here is executed.

candidates.title: Dead 'Delete' affordance on projects page
candidates.observed: projects.jsp:152 renders Delete for every project, but web.xml maps only /projects (web.xml:71-78). GET /projects/delete reaches the container with no servlet and returns HTTP 404.
candidates.intended: Either a working delete endpoint or no link.
candidates.repro: Login -> GET /projects -> click any Delete link -> HTTP 404; project unchanged.

candidates.title: bulkClose bypasses the approval policy and has no role gate
candidates.observed: TaskActionServlet dispatches action=bulkClose before any role check (TaskActionServlet.java:26-29); handleBulkClose (76-88) checks nothing; TaskDao.bulkClose sets status='DONE' for every selected non-DONE task including PENDING_APPROVAL (TaskDao.java:136-137). AuthFilter gates only approve/reject (AuthFilter.java:40-46). A MEMBER or VIEWER can therefore close PENDING_APPROVAL tasks.
candidates.intended: README domain: 'Only ADMIN/MANAGER may approve or reject tasks awaiting approval'. Closing a PENDING_APPROVAL task is an approval-shaped transition.
candidates.repro: Login as dev (MEMBER) -> POST /tasks/action action=bulkClose&ids=3 (seed task 3 is PENDING_APPROVAL) -> 302, task 3 DONE. Contrast: POST action=approve&id=3 as dev -> 403.

candidates.title: ARCHIVED projects still accept tasks; unknown form id silently renders 'New task'
candidates.observed: TaskFormServlet validates projectId only via ProjectDao.exists, whose SQL has no state predicate (ProjectDao.java:45-55; TaskFormServlet.java:50-53), so tasks can be created in/edited into ARCHIVED project 3 'Legacy Archive'. Separately, GET /tasks/form?id=<unknown> leaves the task attribute null and task-form.jsp:27 renders the 'New task' form instead of a 404.
candidates.intended: Source is silent on both; a task tracker conventionally blocks archived projects and reports not-found.
candidates.repro: POST /tasks/form title=Ghost&projectId=3 -> 302 saved=1, task persists with project 'Legacy Archive'. GET /tasks/form?id=999 -> 200 'New task'.

candidates.title: Stored markup renders unescaped in JSPs (XSS candidate)
candidates.observed: JSPs interpolate task/project fields with bare EL (e.g. tasks.jsp:49 ${t.title}, projects.jsp:140 ${p.name}); plain JSP EL does not HTML-escape, so stored markup executes.
candidates.repro: POST /tasks/form with title <script>alert(1)</script> and projectId=1 -> open /tasks -> script markup present in HTML.

candidates.title: Unvalidated numeric parameters surface as HTTP 500
candidates.observed: Long.parseLong on request params without try/catch: TaskActionServlet.java:31 (id) and 84 (bulk ids), TaskFormServlet.java:50 (projectId), 61 (assigneeId), 69 (edit id), TaskListServlet.java:31 (assignee), ProjectServlet.java:34 (archive id).

candidates.title: bulkClose gives no feedback (skips DONE silently; empty selection silent success)
candidates.observed: TaskDao.bulkClose returns the affected row count but TaskActionServlet ignores it (86-87); already-DONE rows are silently skipped (WHERE status <> 'DONE'); empty selection redirects as if successful (78-81).
candidates.intended: Report how many tasks were closed.
candidates.repro: POST action=bulkClose&ids=3&ids=4 (3 PENDING_APPROVAL, 4 DONE) -> 302 with no indication task 4 was skipped.

candidates.title: Plaintext password storage/comparison; /api/* unauthenticated
candidates.observed: PersonDao.authenticate compares the password inside the SQL WHERE clause in plaintext (PersonDao.java:18; schema.sql:13). AuthFilter exempts /api/* (AuthFilter.java:28) so the task readback is public; the API omits description but exposes titles, assignees, projects.
candidates.intended: The API exemption is documented as intended in ApiTaskServlet.java:14-17; listed so the verifier confirms exposure is acceptable. Password hashing absent entirely.
candidates.repro: Anonymous GET /api/tasks -> 200 JSON without any session.

candidates.title: API JSON escaping is quote/backslash only; control characters break the payload
candidates.observed: ApiTaskServlet.esc (51-54) escapes only backslash and double-quote; a newline or tab stored in title/status/etc. is emitted raw inside a JSON string token, producing invalid JSON; HTML chars are not escaped either. Content reaches the DB because the form layer never restricts it.
candidates.repro: POST /tasks/form with a title containing a literal newline (craftable via raw POST; the HTML form input is single-line but the server never enforces that) -> GET /api/tasks -> body no longer parses as JSON.
